context: Tests whether /spring-service-test writes UC001RegisterGuestServiceTest as the integration layer of a Hilla project (docs/architecture/stack.md names Service as the integration layer): it calls GuestService directly, reuses the existing UseCase annotation and TestcontainersConfiguration, arranges the already-registered guest through the use case's repeatable Flyway test migration, tests BR-001, BR-002 and BR-003 with an allowed and a rejected case at the rule's boundary, asserts the specification's messages exactly, fixes the clock, does not mock the call chain, is not @Transactional, and reports honestly that the tests were not run. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Class name and location
checklist.description: The test class is named UC001RegisterGuestServiceTest in src/test/java/com/example/hotel/guest

checklist.name: @UseCase on every test method
checklist.description: Every test method carries @UseCase(id = "UC-001", ...) with scenario values matching 'A1: Email Already Registered' / 'A2: Guest Too Young' where applicable and businessRules naming BR-002 / BR-003

checklist.name: Reuses existing annotation and container setup
checklist.description: Imports com.example.hotel.usecase.UseCase and uses the existing TestcontainersConfiguration (e.g. @Import); does not create a second UseCase annotation or a second container definition

checklist.name: Test data from the use case's test migration
checklist.description: The already-registered guest needed by the BR-002 rejection comes from a repeatable Flyway test migration src/test/resources/db/migration/R__uc001_register_guest.sql (inserting a guest with nextval('guest_seq')), loaded by Flyway's default location without a @TestPropertySource or profile; the test does not create that fixture by calling GuestService.register or GuestRepository.insert first

checklist.name: BR-002 allowed and rejected
checklist.description: One test registers a guest with a new email successfully (asserting the returned guest's data and its registeredAt from the fixed clock) and one shows a registration with an email that is already registered throwing EmailAlreadyRegisteredException

checklist.name: BR-003 boundary cases
checklist.description: One test accepts a guest whose 18th birthday is exactly the arrival date and one rejects a guest one day younger with GuestTooYoungException — not arbitrary ages far from the boundary

checklist.name: Exact messages
checklist.description: Rejections assert the full message with hasMessage("The email address ... is already registered.") and hasMessage("Guests must be at least 18 years old on the day of arrival."), not hasMessageContaining

checklist.name: Validation covered
checklist.description: At least one test shows a missing required field (BR-001) rejected with ConstraintViolationException

checklist.name: Real call chain, no mocks
checklist.description: GuestService and GuestRepository are real beans; no @MockitoBean (or other mock) on them

checklist.name: No @Transactional test, targeted cleanup
checklist.description: The test class is not annotated @Transactional; cleanup removes only the guests the tests created (e.g. by id or test email), not all rows

checklist.name: Fixed clock
checklist.description: A fixed Clock replaces the system clock in the test context (e.g. @TestConfiguration with a @Primary Clock), or the agent explains why it is unnecessary for the asserted values

checklist.name: No production or docs changes
checklist.description: No file under src/main changes; nothing under docs/ changes except the spring-service-test rows of the Markers table (Test row for @UseCase, Name row for UC<id><Name>ServiceTest), the existing rows kept (new sections appended to docs/open_questions.md for a gap the agent found do not count as a change)

checklist.name: Honest report and hand-off
checklist.description: The report states that the tests could not be run here (no Docker) rather than claiming they pass, and ends with the line Next: /hilla-ui-test UC-001 (the UI test skill above; the project has no API layer) — not /spring-rest-test
